description: Remediation of the P3.17 audit defect: the prior dogfood used a second OMP-primary process invoking Hermes adapter code directly, not a real Hermes host. This evidence proves a genuine external Hermes Agent process (separate installed binary, separate Python 3.11 runtime, separate OAuth session) consumed the handoff.
defect_being_remediated: Independent GitHub audit: 'current final dogfood used OMP-primary source -> second OMP-primary session invoking the Hermes adapter path... Do not treat an OMP process calling Hermes adapter code as a real Hermes-host proof.'
remediation_summary: Added a genuine Hermes Agent tool (second_brain_handoff_read) to the already-installed brainstem/adapters/hermes plugin (hermes_plugin.py + plugin.yaml), synced it into the real installed plugin copy at the Hermes 'dev' profile, and ran the real `hermes` CLI (C:/Users/assas/AppData/Local/hermes/bin/hermes.cmd, Hermes Agent v0.20.5, Python 3.11.16, separate install at C:/Users/assas/AppData/Local/hermes/hermes-agent) as profile 'dev' (bot_name=Brain-Dev) in bounded oneshot mode. The tool internally calls the unchanged _BrainClient.request() -> `second_brain autoinject hermes-hook` -> hermes_adapter.handle_request(event=handoff_read) path -- the same adapter code, but now invoked by a real external Hermes process instead of an OMP subprocess.

source.driver_omp_session: envelope created by a real OMP-primary bash tool call (second_brain handoff create) on the live session capsule

real_hermes_host.plugin_doctor: PASS -- manifest second-brain-hermes 0.1.0 (standalone); runtime discovery, manifest parsing, import, and registration passed; registrations: 5 tool(s), 7 hook(s)

recovered_state.note: Only the 1462-2000-ish byte bounded envelope JSON was ever passed to the real Hermes process (as a tool-call argument constructed by the model from the prompt text); no OMP conversation history, session transcript, or ledger was accessible to or supplied to the Hermes process.

verification_chain: real OMP-primary source session -> canonical BrainHandoffEnvelope (created via `second_brain handoff create`)
-> real Hermes host process (hermes.cmd, profile dev, bot_name Brain-Dev, genuine Codex OAuth session)

-> handoff_read through the Hermes adapter (second_brain_handoff_read tool -> hermes_plugin._BrainClient.request -> `second_brain autoinject hermes-hook` -> hermes_adapter.handle_request event=handoff_read)
-> canonical hashes (capsule_sha256, payload_sha256, payload_canonical_sha256) match the source envelope exactly
-> no source transcript supplied (only the bounded envelope object)
